text:
Total consideration consists of cash of $31.00 per share for Company Common Stock outstanding at the Effective Time, plus stock consideration for Residual Shares converted into Parent Common Stock at the Exchange Ratio (Assumed Shares).
- Merger Consideration: $31.00 in cash per share of Company Common Stock outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time, excluding Canceled Shares, Dissenting Shares and Subsidiary Converted Shares.
- Cash-Out Stock Options: cash equal to (Merger Consideration minus the exercise price) times the number of shares subject to such Cash-Out Stock Option, payable at or as soon as reasonably practicable following the Effective Time.
- Cash-Out RSUs: cash equal to the Merger Consideration times the number of shares subject to such Cash-Out RSUs, payable at or as soon as reasonably practicable following the Effective Time.
- Rollover RSUs: converted at the Effective Time into a restricted stock unit of Parent stock, determined by multiplying the number of shares of Class A Common Stock subject to such Rollover RSU immediately prior to the Effective Time by the Exchange Ratio (rounded down to the nearest whole share).
- Residual Shares/Assumed Shares: any remaining shares for issuance under the Company Stock Plan shall be converted into the number of shares of Parent Common Stock equal to the product of the Residual Shares and the Exchange Ratio (the Assumed Shares).
- Exchange Ratio: defined as a fraction, the numerator of which is the Merger Consideration and the denominator of which is the average closing price per share of Parent Common Stock on the New York Stock Exchange Composite Transactions Tape on the twenty (20) trading days immediately preceding the date on which the Effective Time occurs.
Exchange Ratio is defined as a fraction, the numerator of which is the Merger Consideration and the denominator of which is the average closing price per share of Parent Common Stock on the New York Stock Exchange Composite Transactions Tape on the twenty (20) trading days immediately preceding the date on which the Effective Time occurs; Merger Consideration is $31.00 in cash per Company Common Stock share.
